detail: Web bundle http:// / ws:// request targets: none (XML namespaces excluded; third-party literals that never become a request: http://[${o}] — zod IPv6/CIDR validation: new URL(`http://[${value}]`) parses, never fetches; http://[${s.value}] — zod IPv6/CIDR validation: new URL(`http://[${value}]`) parses, never fetches; http://json-schema.org — JSON Schema $schema identifier (zod toJSONSchema), not fetched; http://localhost — react-router createURL fallback base when window is undefined (SSR); the browser uses window.location.origin); the Convex URLs come only from VITE_CONVEX_URL / VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL at build time, so a hosted build is https exactly when its build env is (store builds: vite.config.ts refuses non-https in mobile mode unless VITE_MOBILE_LOCAL=true). iOS Info.plist: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads absent, NSExceptionDomains absent, NSAllowsLocalNetworking present (line 31; judged per Q6). Android main manifest: usesCleartextTraffic="false" (line 12); network security config only in src/debug (cleartext domains localhost, 127.0.0.1, 172.20.10.6), merged into debug builds only. capacitor.config.ts: server.url not set, cleartext false, androidScheme https.
